sections.heading: 一、耶和华的荣美 / Of Jehovah

blocks.en: Ps. 27:4. To behold the beauty of the Lord. IV. 204. Ps. 90:17. Let the beauty of the Lord our God be upon us. V. 114-117. Isa. 33:17. The King in His beauty. VIII. 165, 166. Zech. 9:17. How great is His beauty! IX. 592.
blocks.zh: 诗篇 27:4 —— 瞻仰他的荣美。90:17 —— 愿主我们神的荣美归于我们身上。以赛亚书 33:17 —— 你的眼必见王的荣美。撒迦利亚书 9:17 —— 他的恩慈何等大！他的荣美何其盛！

grammar.note: Let the beauty … be upon us：Let 式祈愿（愿荣美归于我们）。
How great is His beauty!：how + 形容词的感叹句，主谓倒装。

sections.heading: 二、圣洁的妆饰 / Of Holiness

blocks.en: 2 Chron. 20:21. Praise the beauty of holiness. VII. 295. Ps. 110:3. In the beauty of holiness. V. 234-237. Ps. 29:2. Worship the Lord in the beauty of holiness. IV. 220-223. Ps. 96:9. V. 152.
blocks.zh: 历代志下 20:21 —— 赞美耶和华……穿上圣洁的礼服（直译：赞美圣洁的妆饰）。诗篇 110:3 —— 以圣洁的妆饰为衣。29:2 —— 以圣洁的妆饰（原文或作以圣洁为妆饰）敬拜耶和华。另参 96:9。

sections.heading: 三、锡安圣所的华美 / Of the Sanctuary in Zion

blocks.en: Ps. 50:2. Out of Zion, the perfection of beauty, God hath shined. IV. 357. Ps. 96:6. Strength and beauty are in His Sanctuary. V. 150, 151. Isa. 60:13. To beautify the place of My Sanctuary. VIII. 349.
blocks.zh: 诗篇 50:2 —— 从全美的锡安中，神已经发光了。96:6 —— 有能力与华美在他圣所。以赛亚书 60:13 —— 修饰我圣所之地（使我圣所之地得荣耀）。

grammar.note: Zion, the perfection of beauty：the perfection of beauty 是 Zion 的同位语（全美的锡安）。

sections.heading: 四、报佳音者脚踪的佳美 / Of the Advancing Steps of Christ's Heralds

blocks.en: Isa. 52:7. How beautiful upon the mountains are the feet of him that bringeth good tidings of good! VIII. 272.
blocks.zh: 以赛亚书 52:7 —— 那报佳音、传平安、报好信、传救恩的……这人的脚登山何等佳美！

grammar.note: How beautiful … are the feet：感叹句中表语前置＋主谓倒装（= the feet … are how beautiful）。
him that bringeth good tidings = him who brings good news（那报好信息的人）。

sections.heading: 五、神所造万物的美好 / Of God's Natural Creation

blocks.en: Eccles. 3:11. He hath made everything beautiful in its time. VI. 456-458, 465.
blocks.zh: 传道书 3:11 —— 神造万物，各按其时成为美好。

grammar.note: made everything beautiful：make + 宾语 + 形容词补语（使万物成为美好）。

beauty.def: n. 荣美，华美（圣经语境常译『荣美』）【四级】

beautify.def: v. 修饰，使美（-fy 使动词尾）

holiness.def: n. 圣洁（the beauty of holiness：圣洁的妆饰）

shined.def: v. 发光（shine 的旧式过去分词，今多作 shone）

advancing.def: adj. 前行的，行进的【四级】
